# Fireworks AI — Fireworks for Startups

Credits for eligible venture-backed startups, expiring one year after joining, usable for inference, image generation, speech-to-text, embeddings, fine-tuning and on-demand GPU deployments. No credit amount is published.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - the vendor publishes no amount |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-16 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🤖 AI & ML](../categories/ai.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Credits expire after 1 year. |
| **When it ends** | Usage rolls into pay-as-you-go pricing; options for higher limits, reserved capacity and tailored support are offered to scaling startups. |


### Not covered

- Reserved compute/GPU commitments — credits apply only to on-demand usage, not long-term reserved GPU capacity or SLAs
- Fireworks professional services
- Premium support

### Notes
